'''Nyubuna Bulul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the owner of [[The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and Casino]], in the [[Center Sphere District]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]] ([[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]) as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. Bulul had skill for business and was the direct competitor to [[Miss Mylla]], with their businesses being neighbors to each other.
